mapper.insert: insert into ai_run (id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userMessageId}, #{actor}, cast(#{actorRolesJson} as jsonb), #{actorAuthVersion}, #{question}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{modelKey}, 'QUEUED', #{priority}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{policyVersion}, #{traceContext}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, queue_seq, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, lease_owner, lease_until, budget_json, usage_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_run where id = #{id}

select id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, queue_seq, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, lease_owner, lease_until, budget_json, usage_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_run where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

select id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, queue_seq, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, lease_owner, lease_until, budget_json, usage_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_run where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by created_at desc limit 1

select id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, queue_seq, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, lease_owner, lease_until, budget_json, usage_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_run where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'PAUSED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') order by case when status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') then 0 when status = 'PAUSED' then 1 else 2 end, priority desc, queue_seq asc limit 1

select id, conversation_id, user_message_id, actor, actor_roles, actor_auth_version, question, agent_key, agent_version, model_key, status, priority, queue_seq, idempotency_key, policy_version, trace_context, lease_owner, lease_until, budget_json, usage_json, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_run where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit}

select c.id from ai_run c where c.status = 'QUEUED' and not exists ( select 1 from ai_run x where x.conversation_id = c.conversation_id and x.status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')) order by c.priority desc, c.queue_seq asc limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_run set status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'QUEUED'
update ai_run set lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} and status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED')
update ai_run set status = #{next}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expected}
update ai_run set status = 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'RUNNING'

update ai_run set status = 'COMPLETED', usage_json = cast(#{usageJson} as jsonb), finished_at = now(), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'QUEUED')

update ai_run set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, usage_json = cast(#{usageJson} as jsonb), finished_at = now(), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED')

update ai_run set status = 'CANCELLED', usage_json = cast(#{usageJson} as jsonb), finished_at = now(), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and status not in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')
update ai_run set status = 'PAUSED', usage_json = cast(#{usageJson} as jsonb), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = null, lease_until = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PAUSE_REQUESTED'
update ai_run set status = 'QUEUED', error_code = null, error_message = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PAUSED'

update ai_run set status = case when status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED') then 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' else 'CANCELLED' end, finished_at = case when status in ('QUEUED', 'PAUSED') then now() else finished_at end, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'PAUSED')
update ai_run set status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_run where status in ('RUNNING', 'PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
select status from ai_run where id = #{id}
update ai_conversation set event_cursor = event_cursor + 1 where id = #{conversationId} returning event_cursor
mapper.insert: insert into ai_run_event (conversation_id, run_id, cursor, type, payload, created_at) values (#{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{cursor}, #{type}, cast(#{payloadJson} as jsonb), #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select cursor, conversation_id, run_id, type, payload, created_at from ai_run_event where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cursor > #{cursor} order by cursor asc limit #{limit}
select coalesce(max(cursor), 0) from ai_run_event where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_tool_call (id, run_id, conversation_id, tool_name, status, decision, deny_reason, args_summary, created_at) values (#{id}, #{runId}, #{conversationId}, #{toolName}, #{status}, #{decision}, #{denyReason}, cast(#{argsSummaryJson} as jsonb), #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update ai_tool_call set status = #{status}, result_summary = cast(#{resultSummaryJson} as jsonb), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, finished_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, run_id, conversation_id, tool_name, status, decision, deny_reason, args_summary, result_summary, duration_ms, trace_id, created_at, finished_at from ai_tool_call where run_id = #{runId} order by created_at asc
select cursor, conversation_id, run_id, type, payload, created_at from ai_run_event where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and cursor = #{cursor}
